A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''con man''' preyed on a number of elderly citizens on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], conning them out of precious heirlooms. Fortunately for the elderly Datooinians, the con man was captured by a treasure hunter, and the stolen items were returned to their owners.<ref name="Preying on the Meek" />
